Criteria for identification of BPL
people
*341. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the criteria adopted to identify the
people below poverty line;
(b) whether it is uniform in all the States;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of parameters in different
States?
Ascertaining people living below
poverty line
†*342. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 'Uniform
Recall Period' and 'Mixed Recall Period'
systems are used to ascertain the number
of people living below the poverty line;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and in what
way the calculation is made under the
systems; and
(c) the assessment of the income of
poor people under both the systems at
present?
Residential buildings in Delhi
*343. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any new
proposal to construct residential buildings
for the welfare of the Central Government
employees in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have allotted
any land for this purpose in Delhi; and
(d) if so, the location-wise details
thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?

Scrapping of PESB's recommended
panel
*344. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of occasions on which
PESB's recommended panel had been
scrapped for reasons other than vigilance/
corruption since formation of Public
Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) in
1987; and
(b) the details thereof, year-wise and
unit-wise?

Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be

Summit held in New Delhi, recently; and

improve bilateral relations between India
and Pakistan?
Vijayawada-Ranchi NH in
Orissa
*346. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS  be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the status of Vijayawada-
Ranchi Highway Project which passes
through Orissa;
(b) whether Government are aware that
this project passes through 12 tribal
dominated districts of Orissa and on
completion, it would open up
opportunities for a large number of tribals
to improve their economy; and
(c) if so, what is the time-frame within
which it would be taken up and completed?
Manpower requirement in IT sector
*347. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any study has been
conducted to assess the manpower
requirement in the Information Technology
Sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the action taken to fill up the gap of
demand and supply of manpower?
Problems of NER
*348. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Eleventh
Plan has recognized the special problems
of the North East Region such as its
geographical location, inadequacy of
physical infrastructure, low level of
entrepreneurship, etc.;
(b) if so, the steps Government have
taken to tackle the North East Region
problems during Eleventh Five Year Plan;
and
(c) the funds allocated during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan?
Expenditure by CPWD
*349. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the capital and revenue

of the annual Budget is spent during the

the directives of Ministry of Finance;
(c) what are the details of the directives;
and
(c) the steps that are being taken to avoid
such a situation?
Supply of nuclear fuel to India
†*350. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
countries have given their consent for
supplying nuclear fuel to India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of the countries with
which India is holding talks in this regard;
(d) whether the countries supplying
nuclear fuel have laid down any condition
before India;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the Government's reaction thereto?
Status of metro lines
*351. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the present status of metro lines of
Central Secretariat-Badarpur, Inderlok-
Mundka, Shahdara-Dilshad Garden and
Kendriya Sachivalaya-Faridabad;
(b) whether there is any time frame to
complete these projects;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the measures Government are taking
for providing road connectivities to these
metro lines and metro stations at every
stage?
Speed limit for vehicles
*352. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a representation from the Road Safety
Forum of Andhra Pradesh to avoid
increasing speed limits for vehicles on roads
and National Highway;
(b) the details of the said representation
from Road Safety Forum;
(c) whether it is a fact that higher speed
would mean more deaths on roads; and
(d) the steps proposed to carefully
consider such measures which negatively
affect road safety?
Regularisation of colonies
*353. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Union Government have
taken a final decision for the regularization
of about 1500 unauthorised colonies in
Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is expected to be announced; and
(c) what benefits about 35 lakhs of
population of these unauthorized colonies
would get and by when?

Expansion of communication services
in U.P.
†*354. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of villages connected to
communication service by Government
under the Telecommunication Expansion
scheme; and
(b) the target set for the year 2007-08?
Growth in the economy
*355. SHRI C. RAMACHAN-
DRAIAH: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the focus of economic
planning over next five years would be on
the ways and means to faster inclusive
growth in the economy;
(b) if so, the objective to bring a policy
change that ensures a four per  cent growth
in agriculture is on the agenda;
(c) how the projected growth rate of
four per cent in agriculture is expected to
be achieved and what measures at the
ground level encompassing rainfed and
irrigated areas would be implemented;
(d) whether poultry, fisheries,
horticulture, sericulture and animal
husbandry would be given the allied sector
status and whether all credit facilities  given
to agriculture would be extended to the
allied sectors; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Unemployment in urban areas
*356. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
unemployment in urban India has risen
sharply, according to the five-yearly
surveys of the National Sample Survey
Organisation (NSSO);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the incidence of joblessness
has gone up rather disturbingly in small
towns when compared to medium-sized
towns and cities over this period;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what steps Government have taken
in the matter?
Reforms in JNNURM
*357. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what are the mandatory reforms
proposed in the Jawaharlal Nehru National
Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM);
(b) whether they are being conditioned
by World Bank loans;
(c) whether the user charges are part of
mandatory reforms; and
(d) whether taxes collected by local
bodies are intended to meet the services,
collecting user charges?
Projected export of IT-BPO Sector
*358. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:

112
(a) whether Government are aware that
according to the latest Report of the
Nasscom-McKinsey, on the IT-BPO
Sector, the projected export may be around
$ 75 billion by 2010;
(b) the efforts being made to impart
latest training to our professionals to carry
out BPO operations matching continuously
upgraded skills around the world; and
(c) whether the BPO operators'
performance is better than the voice
operations and whether "voice" segment
be so restructured and enabling
circumstances created, for getting maximum
BPO business, both in 'operation' and
"Voice" disciplines?
University for PIOs
*359. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to set up a
University for PIOs;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this University would run
all the courses that are being organized by
the foreign universities; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Toll tax barriers on NHs
†*360. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of toll tax barriers
installed by the National Highways
Authority of India in the whole country,
the details thereof, State-wise;
(b) the amount of revenue collected by
Central Government per annum from these
toll tax barriers; and
(c) whether Central Government
propose to install toll tax barriers in
Haryana and Punjab during the next one
year?
